decisions.reason: Correctly walks resolve(): snapshot succeeds, current missing, id undefined, null per keystroke; onKeyDown exits before preventDefault; explains both silences (four presence probes survive since only a snapshot field is gone; undefined is a legitimate no-session state quietly ignored) without claiming removal/throw.

Type walk shows SessionListState.current removed, navigation moved to view owners per ISessions doc; maps uiSession.adapter.current (ObservableSnapshot<SessionBindingValue>) with key replacing current and ctx replacing sessions.scope(id), full shape given.

Single build reads uiSession.adapter.current.getSnapshot() when available with legacy current+scope fallback; conversation via binding.ctx and input.for(actx); inject gains uiSession, with sound handling of hard-inject semantics on alpha.1.

Correctly names field-level removal behind service-level stability and specifies capability probes (assert current / feature-detect uiSession), but insists the probe runs at activation (one tick deferred) and rejects per-use/lazy checking the rubric requires.

Covers adapter.current key probe, chord behavior on both hosts, and loud deprecated getter/warn prevention, but omits typecheck against alpha.2 published types as a pre-ship gate (only mentions @deprecated types in passing).

caps.reason: Final remedy is the resolve() code rewrite plus uiSession injection; slot re-registration is explicitly rejected as a misdiagnosis.
